description: Plano Rodoviário Municipal 1979 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Índice dos mapas relativos ao Plano Rodoviário Municipal aprovado pelo Decreto nº 16.233 de 30/11/1979 e modificado pelo Decreto n.º 16.702 de 30/11/1980 nas escalas 1:20.000 e 1:50.000. As folhas são aderentes ao Sistema Cartográfico Metropolitano (SCM) criado e implantado pelo Grupo Executivo da Grande São Paulo (GEGRAN). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are articulação, logradouro, legislação, planningCadastre, imageryBaseMapsEarthCover. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
